qualification: The 300-second joint run exposed six false UI timeout labels, with zero hardware timeout events. Display logic alone was corrected, then a further 60-second real Notebook acquisition and controlled browser timeout/recovery checks passed. Firmware, thresholds, capture and car control were not altered by that display fix.
limitations: Configured rules observed; not a complete fault diagnosis or long-term vehicle safety qualification.
This live load uses the car base profile with zero fault windows, not maximum multi-window UI load.
Same-bit text wire testing, physical storage/overload boundaries and latest full power-cycle recovery remain separate acceptance items.
